sentences.text:
Ramnarayan vs State Of Rajasthan (2025:Rj-Jd:39394) on 4
September, 2025
[2025:Rj-Jd:39394]
 High Court Of Judicature For Rajasthan At

S.B. Criminal Misc(Pet.) No. 7299/2025
Ramnarayan S/o Pusaram, Aged About 54 Years, R/o Khangta,
Pipar City, Jodhpur Rural.
 ----Petitioner
 Versus
1. State Of Rajasthan, Through P.p
2. Superintedent Of Police, Jodhpur Rural
For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Devendra Singh Rathore.

For Respondent(s) : Mr. Narendra Singh Chandawat, Pp.
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Mukesh Rajpurohit
Order 04/09/2025
1.

The instant criminal misc. petition has been filed under Section 528 of the BNSS praying that a direction be issued to the respondents to conduct fair, proper, impartial and expeditious investigation in the case arising out of FIR No.107/2025, Police Station- Pipar City, Jodhpur Rural for the offences under Sections 420, 406, 467, 468, 471, 120B and 409 of IPC.

entities.text: Police Station- Pipar City, Jodhpur Rural
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that despite disclosing commission of cognizable offences no heed has been paid by the Investigating Agency as till date no effective action has been taken under the influence of the accused party & thus he seeks fair, impartial and expeditious investigation in this matter.
3. Seeking fair impartial and expeditious investigation is a fundamental right of a person, be he a complainant/victim or the accused.

It is therefore directed that the petitioner shall submit a [2025:RJ-JD:39394] (2 of 2) [CRLMP-7299/2025] representation to the concerned Superintendent of Police along with all documents on which he places reliance.

The concerned Superintendent of Police is expected to consider the averments made in the representation and to instruct the Investigating Officer of this case to conduct fair and impartial investigation and submit the result of the investigation as expeditiously as possible.
The representation shall be submitted by the petitioner within 20 days from today and thereafter, it is expected from the agency to reach on a conclusion within two months.
